title: CAGE — UFC Fight Outcome Predictor
description: Built an end-to-end MLOps system that predicts UFC fight outcomes. Trained and selected my own model (LightGBM, 59.6% balanced accuracy on unseen fights) on ~8,500 fights, then served it through a FastAPI API and a React web app. Leakage-safe training, MLflow tracking, versioned model contracts, TreeSHAP explainability, and 212 tests.

title: ProductShotAI
description: Built a production-grade multimodal AI SaaS platform that transforms product photos into studio-quality images and ad creatives using Google Gemini. Architected with Next.js, FastAPI, and AWS (ECS Fargate, SQS, DynamoDB) with Terraform IaC.

title: AWS RAG Chatbot
description: Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot using Amazon Lex, integrated with an Amazon Bedrock knowledge base populated with documents stored in an S3 bucket, to provide natural language responses about a fictional company.

title: Auto Assistant 360
description: Developed an autonomous AI support agent using Python and OpenAI's Agent SDK during an internal hackathon at CGI.

title: GenAI Document Q&A
description: Developed a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system enabling natural language queries on user-uploaded PDF documents.

title: Azure Based Nextcloud Deployment
description: I deployed and secured Nextcloud on an Ubuntu server in Azure to gain hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, virtual networks, and secure server configuration, while providing a private cloud storage solution.

title: Splunk Monitoring and Analysis
description: For practice, I deployed Splunk Enterprise and utilized the BOTSv3 dataset to simulate a real-world security environment.

title: Portfolio Website
description: I built a responsive web page using React and Vite to showcase my resume, skills, and experience.

title: Neuraset Medical Simulator
description: I developed embedded software for a consumer EEG neurofeedback device based on patent, analyzing brain activity and providing personalized treatments using the LENS protocol.
